# Pesher Psalms Column 3 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Psalms Column 3 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 3:1 — "glory of the pastures" vs. "flowers in a meadow"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the glory of the pastures" | Literal *kikar ha-keramim* |
| LOGOS | "the glory of the pastures" | Standard Psalm rendering |
| PNEUMA | "flowers in a meadow" | Dynamic — vivid concrete imagery |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the glory of the pastures" (EMET/LOGOS). The Hebrew *kevod* means "glory/splendor," not "flowers." PNEUMA's rendering imports a concrete image not in the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 3:4 — "congregation of evil-doers" vs. "assembly of evildoers" vs. "company of evildoers"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "congregation of evil-doers" | Literal with hyphenated compound |
| LOGOS | "assembly of evildoers" | Formal — *edah* as "assembly" |
| PNEUMA | "company of evildoers" | Modern, accessible |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "congregation of evildoers" — *edah* is consistently rendered "congregation" throughout this pesher for consistency with "Congregation of the Poor."

**Status:** Resolved — compromise (EMET's "congregation" + LOGOS's unhyphenated form).

---

## 3:6-7 — Psalm 37:21 — "is gracious and gives" vs. "give generously and freely"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the righteous-one is gracious and gives" | Literal Hebrew |
| LOGOS | "the righteous is gracious and gives" | Standard Psalm form |
| PNEUMA | "the righteous give generously and freely" | Expanded for impact |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS — faithful to the Hebrew *chonen ve-noten*. PNEUMA adds "generously and freely" which are not in the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:8 — "Congregation of the Poor" — consistency of community title

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "congregation of the poor-ones" | Literal with hyphen |
| LOGOS | "Congregation of the Poor" | Capitalized title |
| PNEUMA | "community of God's poor" | Adds "God's" for clarity |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "Congregation of the Poor" — consistent with Col. 1 ruling. Capitalized as a recognized self-designation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:9 — "high mountain of Israel" vs. "holy heights of Israel"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the high mountain of Israel" | Literal *har merom Yisrael* |
| LOGOS | "the high mountain of Israel" | Standard rendering |
| PNEUMA | "the holy heights of Israel" | "Heights" for poetic register |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the high mountain of Israel" (EMET/LOGOS). The Hebrew is *merom* ("height/high place"), and "mountain" is explicit. PNEUMA's "heights" loses the singular mountain motif.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 3:11-12 — Psalm 37:23 rendering — "steps of a man" vs. "a person's steps"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "The steps of a man are established by the LORD" | Literal Hebrew word order |
| LOGOS | "The steps of a man are established by the LORD" | Same as EMET |
| PNEUMA | "The LORD directs a person's steps" | Restructured, gender-neutral |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS — preserves the Hebrew word order and the Psalmic register. PNEUMA's restructuring and gender-neutralization alter the text unnecessarily.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 3:13 — "the priest" vs. "the Priest"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the priest, the Teacher of Righteousness" | Lowercase — descriptive |
| LOGOS | "the Priest, the Teacher of Righteousness" | Capitalized as sectarian title |
| PNEUMA | "the Priest — the Teacher of Righteousness" | Capitalized with em-dash |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS capitalization "the Priest" — in Qumran texts *ha-kohen* functions as a title, not merely a description. Em-dash (PNEUMA) is acceptable but comma (LOGOS) is cleaner.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:14 — "to build for Him the congregation" vs. "to build a community"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "to build for Him the congregation of" | Preserves *livnot lo et adat* |
| LOGOS | "to build for Him the congregation of" | Same as EMET |
| PNEUMA | "to build a community of" | Drops "for Him" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS — "for Him" is theologically important: the Teacher builds the congregation *for God*, not on his own authority.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements for Column 3: 8**
